method: Preselected 12-case screen: 11 real questions plus one negative control. Seven yielded records on the initial pass; all their 32 top-five records were screened from titles and provider abstracts. Failed/empty cases remain in query-level denominators. Direct requires explicit fit to the full requested topic/constraints; supporting means related but a requirement is unconfirmed or missing. Do not equate supporting with assignment compliance. Not an independent, blinded, human or full-text review. Undergraduates are not inferred from generic university-student labels. No causal effect is inferred from self-report or correlation. No scientific-validity grade.
